title: Possible AWS secret access key in source
description: A 40-character secret-shaped value assigned to aws_secret_access_key was found in source. A live secret authenticates as the account that owns it, so treat every hit as a revocation candidate until proven otherwise.
remediation: If this is a real secret, revoke it in IAM immediately, rotate anything it could access, and move credentials to environment variables or a secret manager. This detection does not prove the key is live.
limitation: Shape-only: a 40-character assignment that cannot prove a live credential. Documentation/example keys are vetoed by the denylist.
